limitations: At each October-December observation, forecast using only the prefix available on that date.
Compare seasonal peak-to-latest, a recent-trend baseline and last year's recorded 90%-recession date shifted one year.
The last-year proxy uses a different water definition and sensor; its errors are disclosed but cannot establish a fair same-target skill gain.
The target is bracketed by a wet and subsequent below-5% observation from the same sensor. Zero interval error means inside that bracket, not an exact date hit.
No later threshold crossing means right-censored, not success, failure or an imputed date. Report missing predictions separately.
Repeated origins overlap; they are not independent events. Regional water extent is not plot workability or observed planting.
Classification and calibration were developed using broader history. Prefix isolation prevents direct look-ahead but does not create a pristine holdout.
Date ranges are method/sampling envelopes, not calibrated confidence intervals. Require field checks; do not promise safe planting.

protocol.calendar: Same crop catalog and explicit land type. Remove salinity, groundwater, current moisture, OPERA readiness and IMERG harvest-risk inputs; choose shortest winter crop occupancy, then earlier Aman field release. Weather/income scores do not select the calendar plan. Evaluate the selected plan again with full inputs.
protocol.priorities: Water 0.5, income 0.3, soil 0.2; unchanged in every run.
interpretation: Scenario practices are stated examples, not farmer interviews.
Differences are model outputs, not measured water savings or validated crop benefits.
Calendar candidates still come from the project catalog, calendars and available replay sowing dates; this is not a reconstruction of officer advice.
No current observation is fabricated. Current-moisture removal can correctly have no effect in these dated release-only examples.
The full system includes local non-NASA evidence. Coastal salinity effects must be attributed to SRDI, not to NASA.
All interventions are shown, including no change and unfavorable results. No case was tuned to force a NASA advantage.
A null final recommendation means an officer must resolve missing or decision-sensitive inputs; ranked alternatives remain discussion material.

Regional salinity is from 2009; the strong-salinity abstention threshold (20% of land) is a conservative review policy, not a calibrated cutoff.
